column1: # "You're not alone": battle lines for the "???" fight (battle/party_join.c).
# Shown as plain battle text at the bottom of the screen, which holds two
# lines: each message is at most two lines, with no {page_break} and no
# {end_wait}. A longer line is several messages, the later ones named ...2, ...3.

column3: You stand well alone.\nNow let me break that.
This is all you are\nwithout them.
I won't watch you fall.\nNot while I can reach you!
You held our bodies.\nNot our hearts.
He was never alone.\nNot for one moment.
Did you think I'd just\nstand there and watch?
We left Vale together.\nWe finish it together!
I felt you holding on,\nIsaac. It broke her hold.
We're all here now.\nYou're not alone!
So this is what\nyou are, Isaac.
